references.text: Joshua gave the priests an order to stand still in the Jordan, which shows the connection between the priests' obedience to Joshua's command.
The priests who carried the ark of the covenant stood on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan, and now Joshua commands them to come up out of the river.
The priests stood in the Jordan until everything was completed as the Lord had commanded Joshua, and this verse marks the end of their task.
The direct result of Joshua's command: when the priests came up out of the Jordan, the waters returned.
Moses also gave commands to the Levites about how they were to carry the ark, and Joshua follows the same pattern as God's chosen leader.
Moses commanded the Levites who carried the Lord's ark of the covenant in the same way that Joshua now commands the priests.
